ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too')
ወትበሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of ይቤ, here spelled ትበ, + -ሎ '3ms to him')
ለዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — to this one (ለ- + m. demonstrative)
ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?)
አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun)
የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, abundant (adjective, masc. sg.; written ብዙኀ, adverbial/predicate) · attributive after an accusative noun (ሞገሰ ብዙኀ 'abundant grace')
ባሕቱ: ባሕቱ — but, however, nevertheless (conjunction; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless')
ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs')
ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
ለብሔረ: ብሔር — to the land of (ለ- 'to, for' + construct) · upon (ለ- marking the place shone upon: አብርሀት ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'she shone upon the land of Ethiopia')
ወትቤ: ይቤ — and she said (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of defective ይቤ)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ቤተ: ቤት — house of (noun, construct) · accusative 'a house' (አተወት ቤተ 'she settled in a house') · ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church' (lit. 'house of Christians')
ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity')
ወለእመቦ: እመ — and if there is (ወ- + ለእመ conditional + ቦ 'there is')
ዘተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — who transgressed, departed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ)
እምዛቲ: ዛቲ — from this (እም- 'from' + feminine demonstrative ዛቲ)
ለዝሉፉ: ዝሉፍ — unidentified, perhaps 'for good, continually' (?) (ለ- + word perhaps related to ዘልፈ; uncertain)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ፈጣሪነ: ፈጣሪ — our creator (agent noun of ፈጠረ + -ነ '1cp our')
ወወሀበቶ: ወሀበ — and she gave him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
ዘወሀባ: ወሀበ — which he gave her (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object suffix)
ዘውስተ: ውስተ — which is in (ዘ- relative + preposition ውስተ)
ነገራ: ነገረ — he told her (3ms perfect, G + -ኣ 'her')
በኵሉ: ኵሉ — in all, by all (በ- + ኵሉ)
መዋዕለ: መዋዕል — days (noun, plural of ዕለት; construct 'days of')
ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
ለንግሥተ: ንግሥት — to/of the queen of (ለ- naming the possessor + noun, construct)
በጽሐ: በጽሐ — he reached, arrived (3ms perfect, G, b-ṣ-ḥ)
እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ)
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition) · conjunction 'until' before a subjunctive (እስከ ይትፌጸም 'until might be fulfilled')
ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
ይቤሉ: ብህለ — they said (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, b-h-l)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun; construct 'son of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደ ታራ ወልደ 'Terah begot a son'; ch. 13)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return')
ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's')
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
ነጋዲ: ነጋዲ — merchant, trader (noun; agent noun of ነገደ; plural ነጋድያን)
ወኪያከ: ኪያ — and you (ወ- + object pronoun ኪያ + -ka '2ms')
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ሐዊረ: ሐዊር — going (verbal noun of ሖረ, accusative; 'to go')
አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
በውእቱ: ውእቱ — in that (በ- + demonstrative, before መዋዕል 'days')
ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
በጥበቡ: ጥበብ — by his wisdom (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ተባዕተ: ተባዕት — male (adjective/noun, accusative; ተባዕተ ውሉደ 'male sons')
አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy')
ጣዖታተ: ጣዖት — idols (noun; plural ጣዖታት, accusative form)
ዘይልህቅ: ልህቀ — who grows, is great (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-)
ዘሎቱ: ለ — to whom, whose (ዘ- + preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ይደሉ: ደለወ — it is fitting, due (3m sg imperfect, d-l-w)
ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
ኢኮኑ: ኮነ — they were not (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, k-w-n)
ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
